description: Your link outreach prospects, newest first, one row per site: domain, url, status (identified, contacted, replied, link_placed or rejected), the article it's for, Domain Rating (dr, with drSource ahrefs; dataforseo marks an estimate for a domain Ahrefs has no number for), contact email and name once found, send and reply dates, the latest reply and how it was classed, follow-ups, and whether a placed link was seen on the page. Each row also gives your next step as the dashboard's queue files it, nextMove: reply, check, followup, send, draft, find, form, queued, waiting, placed or ended (check: a placement not yet seen on their page; form: no email found, so use their contact form; ended: rejected or bounced). stage says where it stands (no_contact, no_email, contact_found, email_drafted, contacted, replied, placed or rejected), and hasDraft whether an email is drafted.

aiSources.description: Set true to list only AI sources: pages AI engines cite for your tracked questions, each with the product or service it offers (aiSource). Needs a product or service in Brand Control.
